description: Small synthetic and redacted policy challenge derived from recurring tax-call language. It is not a prevalence sample, benchmark, training set, golden set, release gate, or model-promotion input.

rows.transcript: Hi <CLIENT>, this is <CPA> returning your scheduled call about the tax documents you uploaded. I will not ask for a password or payment on this call.
This is <ENROLLED_AGENT> from your tax preparer's office. You asked us to call after reviewing the state notice. Please use the portal if you need to send anything.
This is <AGENT> returning the callback you scheduled about case <REDACTED>. Do not give payment information by phone; verify the callback using the number published on IRS.gov.
Hello <TAXPAYER>, the state taxpayer-assistance office is returning your requested call. Please open your existing portal case; no payment or verification code is needed on this call.
Hi, this is <CALLER>. Based on your file, you may still have federal or state tax matters worth reviewing. Press one or call 202-555-0101.
This is <CALLER> with a tax resolution service. If you still have unresolved tax debt, there may be programs available. Press one or call 202-555-0102.
I reviewed your tax file briefly and it looks like you may still be eligible to reduce what you owe. Call 202-555-0103.
There may still be tax resolution options that were not fully evaluated during the original review. Press one or call 202-555-0104.
<CALLER> here again. If you believe you may still have taxes due, now is a good time to review your options. Press one or call 202-555-0111.
This is <CALLER> following up regarding your tax relief inquiry. Call 202-555-0112. Press nine if this is no longer relevant.
This is <CALLER> with the taxpayer advocacy division. I was reviewing your file and there may still be opportunities to address a portion of your balance. Call 202-555-0113.
Many people assume their options have expired, but that is not always the case. Press one now or call 202-555-0114 before the review period ends.
This is the tax enforcement unit. Pay today with gift cards or officers will arrive within one hour. Stay on the line and read every card number.
Your tax account has an arrest warrant. Transfer cryptocurrency to the wallet I provide now and do not contact your bank or tax preparer.
I am calling from the IRS refund desk. Read me the six-digit code that just arrived so I can release your refund.
To stop immediate tax penalties, install the remote-support app and give me your banking login while I secure your account.
